notes: V23, nested journal boundaries: Chandra, Flame's Catalyst's −2 ('You may cast target red instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.') casts Crash Through ('Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn. Draw a card.') from the graveyard while the −2 resolves. Top Junk starts in hand, so the hand ends with it and the one card drawn.
